prompt: Inside a professional music studio, a grand piano stands beside an electric guitar and an acoustic guitar leaning against an amplifier. A drum kit complete with cymbals and a pair of drumsticks rests on a patterned rug near a keyboard controller. A microphone fitted with a pop filter is positioned in front of a music stand holding sheet music. On a wooden desk, a mixing console is flanked by two studio monitors, and a pair of headphones hangs from a hook above coiled audio cables on the floor. A mechanical metronome ticks beside an effects pedal, while a recording computer displays its session next to a MIDI controller. Soundproof foam panels cover the walls, and a turntable sits beneath a floor lamp. There is no smartphone, no water bottle, no plastic cup, no soda can, and no cellphone.
